archive_note: Prior published release before the 2026-10-23 district-probability alignment. Forecast inputs are dated 2026-10-21. Its House seat total used Trial 14 while its district probabilities remained on the prior ten-expert MoE stream.

generic_ballot.source_label: PollingForecast-compatible merged poll archive (RCP plus existing poll inputs)
generic_ballot.display_type: polling average, not an election-day forecast

external_poll.status: public context only; not included in the district forecast

generic_ballot.margin_definition: D/R two-party margin, 100 * (D share - R share) / (D share + R share). RCP uses margin_two_party_pp; existing PollingForecast rows use the PF-compatible margin field. adjusted_margin is not used.
generic_ballot.timing_rule: Include fieldwork ending on/before the report cutoff unless a verified first_public_date is after the cutoff. Unknown first-public dates remain unknown and are included with that limitation; archive_ingestion_date is never treated as first-public evidence.

House.method: House seat-total outlook from the Trial 14 Random Forest classifier, trained on election outcomes through 2024. Expected seats and ranges use its 435 district win probabilities in an independent-race Poisson-binomial distribution. House district margins, published district win probabilities, and favored-district counts remain from the ten-expert MoE.

Senate.coverage_note: Full-chamber outlook: 35 forecast races plus 65 fixed seats (34 Democratic-caucus and 31 Republican).

Governor.coverage_note: Covers all 36 Governor races; polling and fallback composition is recorded in the source audit.

senate_seat_distribution.interpretation: Approximate Senate seat range from 35 race probabilities and 65 fixed seats; not a party-control probability.

summary.seat_range_note: Seat ranges use independent Poisson-binomial calculations from the published race probabilities; Senate includes 65 fixed seats (34 Democratic-caucus and 31 Republican).

governor_seat_distribution.interpretation: Range of Democratic wins across 36 Governor races under an independent-race assumption; this is a race-count range, not a party-control probability.

generic_ballot_forecast.target: National Democratic-minus-Republican House two-party popular-vote margin in percentage points
